alloy.preparation: Arc-melted elemental chips under argon (Al, Y and Gd 99.9%; Fe 99.98%; Ni 99.99%); single-roller melt-spinning under helium on a 0.20-m copper wheel at about 45 m/s. test_solution.preparation: ACS-certified reagents and deionized water of 18 MΩ cm resistivity; deaerated with nitrogen gas.

test_method.procedure_description: 300-ml flat electrochemical cell, platinum-mesh counter electrode and SCE reference (reported accuracy ±2 mV).
